_comment: PII linter hook for Moonshot Kimi CLI.
Install: `pii-lint install-hooks kimi` merges this into
PostToolUse: after Kimi writes/edits a file, scan it. The env var
$KIMI_TOOL_FILE_PATH is set when the hook fires.
Exit 2 on HIGH+ to force Kimi to redact.
Stop:        at end-of-turn, scan the staged diff. Exit 2 forces
cleanup before the agent signs off.

hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$KIMI_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.csv|*.jsonl|*.md) pii-lint scan -- "$f" || exit 2;; esac'
